howToUse: Take 2 capsules of this Ayurvedic testosterone booster daily with a glass of water or milk. Note: You can divide the shilajit capsules by taking one in the morning and one in the evening, after your meals. If you prefer having two at once, do have it at night.

faqs.question: How many TOSTERO Shilajit Capsules do I take daily?
faqs.answer: 2 capsules a day with water or milk. We don't recommend exceeding this limit.

faqs.question: For how long do I take these Shilajit tablets to see a difference?
faqs.answer: The tostero capsules gets you results if taken regularly over a 3-4 month period. So don't rush it.

faqs.question: Do these Shilajit Tablets provide a permanent solution?
faqs.answer: Nothing in life is permanent, including your well-being. We recommend taking the capsule continuously, to keep your testosterone at a healthy level.

faqs.question: Does this testosterone booster help with PE?
faqs.answer: No, these booster for men are not supposed to help with PE.

faqs.question: Are there any side effects from consuming this natural testosterone booster for men?
faqs.answer: These tablets are made from natural ingredients which makes it safe to take for longer periods without causing any side effects

faqs.question: Can I use these shilajit capsules if I'm going to gym?
faqs.answer: You can use these tablets to improve strength and endurance at the gym. With regular consumption, they naturally help boost strength so that you can lift more weights and run that extra mile.

faqs.question: Are these shilajit tablets similar to steroid supplements?
faqs.answer: No, this an Ayurvedic testosterone booster which is 100% natural and won't cause any side effects. While these tablets help in boosting strength and endurance, they are not steroids.
